mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", scope AS "scope", ref_id AS "refId", orig_name AS "origName", stored_name AS "storedName", size_bytes AS "sizeBytes", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = uploaded_by LIMIT 1), uploaded_by) AS "uploadedBy", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM attachment WHERE scope = #{scope} AND ref_id IN #{refId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id AS "id", scope AS "scope", ref_id AS "refId", orig_name AS "origName", stored_name AS "storedName", size_bytes AS "sizeBytes", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = uploaded_by LIMIT 1), uploaded_by) AS "uploadedBy", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM attachment WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment (scope, ref_id, orig_name, stored_name, size_bytes, uploaded_by, created_at) VALUES (#{scope}, #{refId}, #{origName}, #{storedName}, #{sizeBytes, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{uploadedBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM attachment WHERE scope = #{scope} AND ref_id = #{refId}
